author: Developer Express Inc.
name: DevExpress Blazor WebAssembly Reporting Project
description: A template for creating a Blazor WebAssembly application with the DevExpress Report Viewer. To start a project, specify the DevExpress NuGet Feed URL as a required feed parameter. Refer to https://nuget.devexpress.com/#feed-url and login to your account to obtain your Feed URL.

nuget-feed.description: Refer to https://nuget.devexpress.com/#feed-url and login to your account to obtain your Feed URL.

add-designer.description: Whether to add a web page that contains the JS-Based Report Designer component.

add-document-viewer.description: Whether to add a web page that contains the JS-Based Document Viewer component.

add-report-viewer.description: Whether to add a web page that contains the Native Report Viewer component.

RegisterJsonDataSource.description: Whether to register a sample connection string to create JSON Data Sources in the Report and Data Source Wizards. This connection string is also used to register a predefined data source in the Report Designer.

framework.description: The target framework for the project.
